component.name: Zeo
component.summary: The Zed editor, rebranded, with the bentoo patch series

description.p: Zeo is a build of the Zed editor with a downstream patch series on top: richer agent-panel integration for the Claude agent adapters, thread organisation, and a few editor refinements. It is a patch set applied to a named Zed commit, not a fork.
Zeo is an independent project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Zed Industries.
